# exampletool

A fast package manager. Written in Python, with a standalone installer.

## Install

```bash
# macOS and Linux
curl -LsSf https://example.invalid/install.sh | sh
```

```powershell
# Windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy ByPass -c "irm https://example.invalid/install.ps1 | iex"
```

Or with pip: `pip install exampletool`.

Note: in PowerShell, `curl` is an alias, so call `curl.exe` explicitly.
